messages:
julia: Final draft for product launch post is uploaded. Quick ask: sanity-check benchmark language, CTA for the launch webinar, and HubSpot form mapping for demo routing. Target publish Wed 9am PT. Please review by EOD.

omar_marketing: Will review benchmarks and the hero claim. Recommend we avoid absolute numbers without test context. Maybe: 'Up to 3x throughput (test conditions below)'.

emily_design: Hero asset needs landscape crop for the header, add alt text 'Throughput bar graph'. I'll drop versions in Figma and flag preferred export sizes.

raj_ops: Ops note: HubSpot form must include hidden fields for source & demo_path and a field for 'demo_owner' so webhooks can route. Recommend canary segment for first 1k signups. Share form id and I'll wire webhooks.

lindsey_sales: For webinar CTA: 'Save your seat  Launch demo  Limited capacity' — SDRs want 'demo_interest' funnel prop. If we hint pricing, tag me and I'll prepare follow-ups.

sam_legal: Quick-pass complete. One edit: swap 'guaranteed uptime' -> 'targeted uptime'. No other legal blockers.

publish-bot: Checklist incomplete: missing hero alt text, HubSpot form id, demo_owner.

omar_marketing: Adding a 2-line benchmark note under Benchmarks: '(tested on Llama-Tiny, seq=512, batch=8; synthetic workload)'. Also adding FAQ blurb to clarify methodology.

emily_design: Uploaded hero + supporting images: https://www.figma.com/file/launch-assets. Alt text added in comments.

raj_ops: Paste this sample mapping into the doc: ```hubspot_form_id: launch_demo_2026 hidden_fields: {"source":"launch_blog","demo_path":"sprint-2026"} demo_owner: demos@redwood.ai``` Once present I'll connect webhook to /demo-scheduler and create canary.

lindsey_sales: Please add HubSpot props: campaign_source, demo_interest (low/med/high), acct_tier (self-serve/enterprise) so SDRs can triage.

julia: Action list: - Omar: finalize benchmark wording + add test conditions (by 3pm PT) - Emily: lock hero + alt text (by 4pm PT) - Sam: legal tweak accepted - Raj: HubSpot form id + canary (by EOD) - Lindsey: follow-up templates (tomorrow AM). If all green I'll hand to release-ops to schedule Wed 9am PT.

publish-bot: Copy of publish checklist (ops): - Copy locked (content + legal) - Hero assets uploaded + alt text - HubSpot form id + hidden fields set - Canary segment created (1k) - Webhook to /demo-scheduler verified - SDR templates present - UTM tracking: utm_source=launch_blog utm_medium=organic utm_campaign=sprint_launch

omar_marketing: Marketing approved the updated language and FAQ.

sam_legal: Legal sign-off logged.

raj_ops: Ops signed off on mapping and scheduling. Will run canary test at 5:10pm PT.

lindsey_sales: I'll upload three follow-up sequences by 10am tomorrow.

julia: Thanks team  locking copy and assigning to release-ops. Will share runbook results after the canary test.
